config.headline: DIGITAL MARKETING | CLIENT STRATEGY & CAMPAIGN MEASUREMENT
config.summary: Digital marketing leader with 14+ years across agency client strategy, multi-channel acquisition, ecommerce, and performance measurement. Consulted with clients on business goals, audiences, budget allocation, SEO, website, email, social, and paid media opportunities. Led an eight-person ecommerce team and built reporting that translates campaign data into clear recommendations.
skills: Paid search, social, email channel experience, SEO collaboration, lead generation, audience strategy, and website planning.
Agency consultation, business-goal discovery, client presentations, cross-functional coordination, and team leadership.
GA4, Google Tag Manager, Tableau, Looker Studio, Funnel.io, attribution, conversion analysis, KPI reporting, and ROI.
Keyword and competitive research, targeting and messaging recommendations, ad copy, landing pages, and A/B and multivariate testing.
Campaign monitoring, budget allocation, reporting automation, project prioritization, and repeatable account-management processes.

selected_evidence.quote: Evaluated customer journeys from reach and micro-conversions through purchase, click-to-call, and lifetime value to identify scalable search and budget opportunities.
Built Tableau dashboards and automated weekly reporting across 10+ channels using Python, Databricks, SQL, Excel, and Funnel.io, improving accuracy and decision speed.
Used regression models, holdouts, geo tests, scale-up/down analysis, and budget reallocation scenarios to forecast outcomes and present credible investment recommendations.
Analyzed max CPC versus smart bidding, brand and non-brand target CPA, Performance Max and Shopping mix, audience performance, data-driven attribution, and incremental CPA.
Coordinated search and broader channel strategy with website, SEO, operations, and creative priorities to maintain efficient delivery and support profitable growth.
Configured GA4 and Google Tag Manager measurement and built Looker Studio KPI dashboards for campaign pacing, website performance, inventory planning, and leadership decisions.
Increased monthly volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5 through bidding strategy, audience analysis, campaign testing, budget allocation, and conversion review.
Managed Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Amazon, Meta, Instagram, and TikTok across an approximately $400K monthly advertising budget.
Directed digital marketing and e-commerce for a large B2B distributor, coordinating execution and reporting across marketing, sales, operations, finance, IT, and product teams.
Maintained marketing databases, financial reporting, and cross-channel systems that improved budget visibility, data consistency, collaboration, and decision-making.
Applied project-by-project cost-benefit analysis to prioritize growth initiatives, marketplace opportunities, product investments, and operational improvements.
Modernized the company’s digital environment and launched multiple B2C channels while protecting relationships with more than 650 B2B retail partners.
Consulted directly with clients on business goals, pain points, budget allocation, campaign structure, SEO, website, email, social, and paid media opportunities.
Built Funnel.io and Looker Studio reporting, created automated monitoring scripts, and developed a repeatable account-management system adopted across the agency.
Conducted keyword and competitive research, developed targeting and messaging recommendations, and created conversion, attribution, A/B, and multivariate testing frameworks.
Managed 75+ Google Ads accounts and more than $276K in monthly spend across search, display, mobile, remarketing, YouTube, lead generation, and multi-channel client programs.
Led an eight-person e-commerce team responsible for paid search, customer acquisition, campaign delivery, website performance, and growth across the U.S., Canada, and U.K.
Created annual projections and KPI reporting with senior leadership and used platform, analytics, Magento, accounting, and competitive data to guide budget and campaign decisions.
Directed keyword strategy, bid experiments, landing-page optimization, ad copy, audience analysis, CRO, attribution, and A/B and multivariate testing.
Managed 150+ campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Amazon, search, shopping, display, video, remarketing, mobile, social, local, and email with approximately $400K in monthly spend.
Managed 150+ campaigns and approximately $400K in monthly spend, generating more than $9 million in revenue and 35% of company sales.
